description: The authenticated user's connected MT5 account (via the SocialForex MT5 Bridge EA): balance, equity, free margin, open positions, pending orders and the last queued commands with their status. Requires a personal SocialForex API token. Create one at /mt5 (section "Connect an AI assistant (MCP)") and add it to the MCP client as header `Authorization: Bearer sfmcp_...`.
name: get_my_mt5_account
title: My MT5 account
